title: Finalize pet battles against the departing player before save and persist detached owned pet health
cause: Logout can detach a Player before WorldSession::LogoutPlayer saves it. PetBattle::Finish used world-filtered lookup for journal updates and release,so it skipped that Player. The battle could remain in CREATION/RUNNING,or finish without saving health/penalty. A late ordinary ForfeitBattle also fails the existing webbed guard and cannot safely read an uninitialized creation ActivePetID. During matchmaking far-transfer,SaveToDB chooses the pending destination rather than only the relocated current pose.

implementation.bound_logout: WorldSession invokes PetBattleSystem::OnPlayerLogout after genuine session logout admission and before SetDelete/save. The system removes the own request/queue proposal,validates both team PlayerGuid and OwnerGuid,and binds only that Player and full battle GUID in a synchronous thread-local RAII scope. No pointer is retained in a battle or delayed companion callback.
implementation.running: Only RUNNING enters Finish. The scoped genuine logout can terminate a trapped battle;ordinary voluntary webbed forfeits still use the native guard. Native GetForfeitHealthPenalityPct remains10 for PvE and0 for PvP. The actual bound Player survives world detachment long enough for journal synchronization. Final-dead/negative health becomes0;living health follows the existing penalty policy exactly once.
implementation.detached_journal: Finish without an available world Player still normalizes and copies its real OriginalBattlePet and marks needSave. UpdateOriginalInstance accepts a null notification receiver. Online XP/achievement/capture/trainer reward paths continue to require their actual Player;offline reward delivery is a separate remaining scope.
implementation.creation: Logout and ordinary early forfeit share CancelUnstartedBattle. It releases only actual battle-bound participants/NPCs,leaves WinnerTeamId unset,and gives no combat penalty,XP or reward. Direct Finish rejects creation,including invalid/uninitialized active-pet IDs. A wild actor rebound to another battle is retained.
implementation.reentry: Internal FINISHING4 rejects repeated completion and is neither updated nor queued for deletion by the manager. FINISHED2 is published after synchronous cleanup. Native callback test recursively calls Finish and runs the actual manager deletion tick while finishing. OnPlayerLogout caches battle type before finalization so subsequent player cleanup does not dereference a completed battle.
implementation.recall: Matchmaking logout validates the real recall location and prepares it as the current saved pose. If a genuine far-transfer is pending,the same validated location replaces the pending save destination while preserving loading state. No teleport ACK or arrival completion is fabricated. Normal connected opponents keep native release/return behavior.
